payout_quote: $200 cash bonus (20,000 points equivalent) when you spend $1,000 within the first 3 billing cycles after account is opened.
steps: Open the official FNBO credit cards page and read the Evergreen offer terms.
Apply for the Evergreen by FNBO Credit Card via the offer page ('offers vary elsewhere'); a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
Spend at least $1,000 within the first 3 billing cycles — only purchases you already planned.
Pay the balance in full each month.
Collect the $200 cash bonus (20,000 points equivalent), redeemable for statement credit, ACH deposit, or check.
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only count the $1,000 of purchases you were already going to make.
No annual fee ($0), so the $200 bonus is yours to keep net if you meet the spend.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.

Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: carrying a balance at a typical ~20%+ variable APR wipes out the $200 fast — always pay in full (check the cardmember agreement for the exact APR before you apply).
Online applications may be limited by state — the application page will confirm eligibility for your ZIP code before you apply.
biggest_catch: The $200 is only free money if the $1,000 is spending you already planned — never stretch your budget to chase it, and pay in full every month since carried-balance interest at ~20%+ APR erases the bonus.
eligibility: New Evergreen cardholders applying via the offer page; $1,000 in purchases within the first 3 billing cycles.
timing: Bonus awarded after the $1,000/3-billing-cycle requirement is met; exact posting timing not stated in the fetched copy.
